name: First Strike
body:
Your travelers are adept at really hurting an enemy on the first round of caravan combat.

Prerequisite: Offense 3.

Benefit: On the first Attack check of any caravan combat, you gain a +4 bonus on the Attack check. If you damage your foe, you deal an additional 4 points of damage.
